title: Trump welcomes Artemis II astronauts to Oval Office and fields questions on Iran, Comey and UFOs
byline: The Artemis II astronauts’ journey to the moon and back landed them at the White House Oval Office on Wednesday afternoon — standing by while President Donald Trump talked UFOs, the Space Force and the Iran war.

title: Govt. seek to establish Central Highlands Protection Authority promptly
byline: A discussion to review the progress of the process to establish a new authority for the protection and restoration of the Central Highlands has been held yesterday (29) at the Presidential Secretariat, under the patronage of President Anura Kumara Dissanayake.

title: Italy recovers 337 looted antiquities from United States
byline: The United States has handed back 337 antiquities looted from Italy in one of the largest recent returns of stolen cultural property, officials said on Wednesday, highlighting deepened cooperation between Rome and Washington.

title: 6 crew members freed from US-seized Iranian container ship
byline: Six Iranian crew members aboard an Iranian-flagged container ship held by the US have been freed and returned to Iran, the semi-official Tasnim news agency reported on Wednesday.

title: Oil price rises above $120 after reports of ‘extended’ Iran blockade
byline: Oil prices have soared following reports that the US is preparing for an ‘‘extended’’ blockade of Iran.

title: Fairly heavy rainfall above 50 mm expected in some parts of the island
byline: Showers or thundershowers will occur in the most parts of the island after 1.00 pm today (30), the Department of Meteorology said.
